newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cosco HK buys 30 pct of Shun Shing.
newsitem.headline: Cosco HK buys 30 pct of Shun Shing.

text.p: Shun Shing Holdings Ltd said its majority shareholder, Golden Success Ltd, had agreed to sell 201.6 million shares, or about 30 percent of Shun Shing, to Cosco (H.K.) Property Development Ltd for HK$0.315 per share.
Golden Success owns about 75 percent of Shun Shing's existing issued share capital, Shun Shing said in a statement.

It said Cosco (H.K.) Property Development, a wholly-owned unit of COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd, would hold the shares as a long term investment and had no present intention to increase its shareholding or inject assets into the company. Cosco (Hong Kong) is the holding company of COSCO Pacific Ltd.

Shun Shing, a construction and property development firm, said three executive directors from Cosco (H.K.) Property would be invited to its board. It said there was no present intention to change the company's business.
Trading in Shun Shing shares was due to resume on Tuesday. The shares closed at HK$0.315 on Friday and were suspended on Monday.
